title: 第1133章 朱家的终局第1132章 新的四大家族
slug: 合欢宗从照顾师弟道侣开始修仙
content_zh:
朱彦祖脸上的神情一阵变幻。
惊疑不定的看着虚空而立的白衣道童。
虽然不知道发生了什么事情。
但既然朱家众人都来到了这片未知的空间。
说明整个朱家都被一网而尽。
就连他的修为也被禁锢了。
难道白衣道童是一位大乘修士？
朱彦祖向前一步。
恭敬的拱手行礼。
正欲开口说些什么时。
“我说过你们已经死了。”
稚嫩的声音再次响了起来。
声音中充满了冷酷无情的冰冷。
下一瞬间，朱家众人脚下的水面突然被点燃了。
燃烧起了熊熊大火。
整个汪洋就好像被点燃了一般。
熊熊燃烧了起来。
化为了一片火海。
“啊！”
一些朱家人发出了惨叫。

倒在地上剧烈的翻滚挣扎着。
他们身上好像与什么东西被点燃了。
火焰在他们身上熊熊燃烧着。
但诡异的是他们身上的衣物却完好无损。
也有一些朱家人一脸不知所措的看着在地上挣扎的族人。
他们虽然也站在火海中。
但那些火焰好像没有任何温度。
朱家几乎三分之二的长老都发出了惨叫。
其中包括朱彦祖与朱玄辰。
“夫君，老祖，你们没事吧。”
两人身旁的美妇被两人的惨状下了一大跳。
六神无主的扑在了朱玄辰的身上。
朱玄辰就好像抓住了救命稻草。
死死的抱住了美妇。
似乎想用美妇的身体扑灭身上的火焰。
content_en:
The expression on Zhu Yanzu's face suddenly changed.
He looked at the white-clothed Taoist boy standing in the void in confusion.
Although I don't know what happened.
But now that everyone in the Zhu family has come to this unknown space.
It means that the entire Zhu family has been wiped out.
Even his cultivation was imprisoned.
Could it be that the Taoist boy in white is a Mahayana monk?
Zhu Yanzu took a step forward.
Bowed respectfully.
When he was about to say something.
"I told you you were dead."
The childish voice sounded again.
The voice was filled with ruthless coldness.
The next moment, the water under the feet of the Zhu family was suddenly ignited.
A raging fire broke out.
The whole ocean seemed to be on fire.
It burst into flames.
It turned into a sea of ​​fire.
"Ah!"
Some of the Zhu family members screamed.
He fell to the ground and rolled violently, struggling.
They seemed to be on fire with something.
The fire burned through them.
But the strange thing is that their clothes are intact.
There were also some Zhu family members who looked at the clansmen struggling on the ground with bewildered expressions.
Although they are also standing in the sea of ​​fire.
But those flames didn't seem to have any temperature.
Almost two-thirds of the elders of the Zhu family screamed.
Among them are Zhu Yanzu and Zhu Xuanchen.
"Husband, ancestor, are you okay?"
The beautiful woman next to the two of them was shocked by the miserable state of the two.
The six gods threw themselves on Zhu Xuanchen.
Zhu Xuanchen seemed to have grasped a life-saving straw.
He hugged the beautiful woman tightly.
It seems that he wants to use the beautiful woman's body to extinguish the flames on his body.
